findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: enrich_b2b_company_leads, enrich_creator_bio_leads, audit_local_b2b_websites · Private data: enrich_b2b_company_leads, search_korea_mfds_oem_filings · Public sink: enrich_creator_bio_leads, audit_local_b2b_websites · Destructive: audit_local_b2b_websites.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: enrich_b2b_company_leads, enrich_creator_bio_leads, audit_local_b2b_websites · Private data: enrich_b2b_company_leads, search_korea_mfds_oem_filings · Public sink: enrich_creator_bio_leads, audit_local_b2b_websites · Destructive: audit_local_b2b_websites

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
